# 0116. Meetings page: this repo only, grouped by month, real meeting names, decisions and to-dos side by…

## Context and Problem Statement

Task #169: feat: meetings in their own place, not a tab of the task page.

## Considered Options

The options are not listed apart; the decision below says what was chosen and why.

## Decision Outcome

Meetings page: this repo only, grouped by month, real meeting names, decisions and to-dos side by side

The user saw halil-workspace meetings on imprimatur's Meetings page and found the list hard to read: 12 rows titled "Toplantı" and every row looking the same.

- Scope: the page always shows the current repo. The sticky "every repo" scope (set when you open another repo's task) has no switch on this page, so it was mixing repos in without showing it.
- Name: a generic title ("Toplantı", "Meeting", "Yarıda kalan kayıt…") gives way to the note's first bold line, which is where the meeting app puts the real name. The stored title stays as written.
- Row: a date tile, the name, the summary's first sentence ("## Özet"), a decisions count and your open to-dos count (accent colour). Rows are grouped under month headings.
- Opened: Decisions and To-dos in two columns, yours first, then the task link and the full note.
- The Meetings tab gets an icon (Lucide "users").

Shipped in 0.133.0.

## Consequences

Not listed apart; see the decision outcome.
